name: webhook-inspector
description: Webhook Inspector — temporary webhook URLs that show every request they receive; a service of the QA Tools platform.

scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && node scripts/db.mjs up
scripts.check:native-ts: node --input-type=module -e "const m = await import('@webhook-inspector/shared'); if (typeof m.SESSION_IDLE_DAYS !== 'number') { throw new Error('shared did not load'); } console.log('native TypeScript resolution ok:', await import.meta.resolve('@webhook-inspector/shared'));"
